title: Internal nodes in the parity circuit tail
statement: For natural numbers $r$ and $q$ and either an AND or an OR gate, the number of internal nodes in the parity circuit tail with parameter $r$, depth parameter $q$, and that output gate is $\sum_{k=0}^{q-1}(r^k 2^r)$, with the sum understood to be zero when $q=0$.
hypotheses_covered: the gate is either AND or OR
